position: Use a verified partner marketplace with role-specific rates, one-level referrals, quality-gated CGC earnings and a transparent monthly payout ledger. Students and parents receive only non-cash points, benefits, awards, scholarships or discounts under separate rules.

chapters.title: Recommended earning architecture
chapters.lead: Use one platform experience with separate ledgers for professional earnings, institutional earnings and non-cash learner benefits.

items: Earn for verified value: a payable event requires delivery, acceptance, quality evidence or a completed commercial milestone.
No income for clicks: logins, profile views, link sharing, likes and free signups do not create cash earnings.
One action, one earning: every transaction uses an idempotency key so retries and duplicate events cannot double-pay.
Role-based visibility: a user sees only rates and actions available to the verified professional or institution role.
No outcome manipulation: counsellors, psychologists and assessment professionals are never paid for steering a learner toward a product, course, career or assessment result.
No hidden deductions: each statement separates gross value, provider share, platform fee, refunds, reserve, taxes, adjustments and final payout.
Prospective changes only: rate changes apply to future bookings unless a signed order form says otherwise.

items: Student activity: assessments, course completion, event participation, CGC questions, contests and referrals by students remain under non-cash points, awards or scholarship rules.
Parent activity: guardian onboarding, consent, attendance, feedback and referrals remain under non-cash points or benefits.
Minor professional profile: no person under 18 may open or withdraw from a Partner Earnings Wallet.
Free signup: neither a learner signup nor a professional signup creates cash until a defined paid or delivered milestone is verified.
Purchase-only reward: paying for membership, courses or events does not create earnings for the purchaser.
Sensitive assessment response: no one earns for selecting a particular psychometric, aptitude or career response.
Unapproved off-platform work: payments arranged outside Career Garage are not recorded or protected by this system.
A parent or former student who is also a verified adult professional must create a separate professional profile.
Earnings are attributed only to the professional profile and verified partner activity, never to learner or guardian behaviour.
Institution employees cannot receive personal commissions for procurement or student routing unless the institution gives written approval and the conflict is disclosed.
Career Garage employees are paid through payroll or an approved contract, not through the marketplace wallet for their assigned duties.

blocks.label: MONTHLY FORMULA
blocks.text: CGC payout = MIN(individual cap, monthly CGC pool x contributor eligible impact units / total eligible impact units). Recommended initial cap: INR 5,000 per contributor per month.

items: Verified counsellors, psychologists, mentors, professionals, teachers, tutors, trainers, course creators and approved moderators.

Students and parents may ask, answer and receive points or badges, but they are excluded from CGC cash earnings.
A moderator cannot approve, endorse or resolve their own contribution.
AI assistance must follow platform disclosure rules; fabricated expertise, copied content and mass-generated answers are ineligible.
Medical, mental-health, legal, financial or safeguarding risk must be escalated instead of answered outside the contributor's scope.
Votes from linked accounts, referral rings, repeated devices or suspicious bursts are excluded before pool calculation.
The monthly pool is published before the period and cannot be reduced retrospectively after eligible work is accepted.

chapters.title: Partner earnings terms - summary
chapters.lead: These clauses should be reflected in the full partner agreement and public policy. The signed agreement and live rate card prevail where they differ.

blocks.text: No guaranteed income. Marketplace demand, eligibility and earnings vary; Career Garage does not promise minimum work or income unless a written retainer does.
Eligibility. Partner must maintain identity, bank, tax, credentials, safeguarding and role approval.
Rates. The rate locked to the booking, order or commission applies. Future rates may change prospectively with notice.
Evidence. An activity is payable only after required delivery and verification evidence is accepted.
Refunds and reversals. Refunds, chargebacks, fraud and corrections may reverse pending or paid earnings under the published policy.
Taxes. Partner is responsible for its tax compliance; Career Garage may deduct and report applicable withholding.
Off-platform payments. Partners may not divert platform customers or collect hidden fees for platform-booked services.
Professional independence. Advice must remain within scope and cannot be influenced by referral, course or membership commission.
Safeguarding and privacy. All minor contact, consent, recording, data access and escalation must follow approved controls.
Intellectual property. Partner warrants originality and grants/assigns only the rights stated in the content order or agreement.
Suspension. Career Garage may restrict listings and hold disputed earnings for credible safety, fraud, legal or credential concerns.
Disputes. Partner must dispute a statement line within 15 calendar days; records remain visible and corrections post as adjustments.
Termination. No new earning accrues after closure; cleared undisputed balances follow the final settlement process.

blocks.label: CONTRACTING RULE
blocks.text: Use separate agreements for employees, independent professionals, affiliates and institutions. Do not use one hybrid document to create a relationship that behaves differently in practice.
